Generate a Maplibre GL Map

genRasterMap.Rd

Generate a Maplibre GL Map

Usage

genRasterMap(
  pol,
  field,
  values = NA,
  n = 5,
  style = "kmeans",
  valClass = NULL,
  mapId = "map1",
  resolution = NULL,
  legendTitle = field,
  legendWidth = "300px",
  legendPos = "top-left",
  addControls = FALSE,
  opacity = 1,
  rsf = NULL
)

Arguments

pol

A sf object.

field

The name of the column to use for classification.

values

values of the dataset.

n

Number of classes

style

Style of classification. One of: "fixed", "sd", "equal", "pretty", "quantile", "kmeans", "hclust", "bclust", "fisher", "jenks", "dpih", "headtails", "maximum", or "box".

valClass

An object of the class classIntervals to set the classification manually

mapId

ID of the map.

resolution

Resolution of the raster.

legendTitle

Legend title.

legendWidth

Width of the legend.

legendPos

Position of the legend.

addControls

Add some controls to the map?

opacity

Opacity of the legend.

rsf

a list of rescaling functions returned from rescale function.

Value

An HTML widget for a Mapbox map.
